messages:
IncidentBot: P1 pager triggered: elevated 5xx and latency on /v1/generate (prod us-east-1). Paging on-call. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/2501234567 :rotating_light:
alex: oncall here, got the pager. looking at dashboards now.
maria: seeing error spike at 14:12 UTC, 5xx rate ~6x baseline. spike aligns with canary rollout 2026-03-15T14:10 (model v2.3-quant).
jordan: adding logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/trace/abc123 (sample traces + request ids).
alex: grabbing a few request ids and a kernel panic line in one node. sharing tail: ```
2026-03-15T14:12:14Z ERROR inference: kvcache miss, tensor-launch failed: cuLaunchKernel error 700
...
```
emily: is this just one host or many?
maria: looks spread across 3 hosts in the canary pool (canary-1..3). production stable pool unaffected so far.
devops-bot: autoscaler suppressed due to reserve policy, can't spin new canary nodes automatically.
liam: can we route canary traffic back to stable? fallback policy exists. alex: yes, we can route using routing policy `route:stable-on-failure` in 2 commands. I'll prepare.
jordan: hypothesis 1: quantized kernel path regression in v2.3-quant causing OOM kernel failures. hypothesis 2: small memleak + batching spike exposing it.
emily: quick smoke: hit canary endpoint with small batch, reproducing error locally?
alex: running quick repro: ```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\",\"batch_size\":8}' https://canary-east.redwood/generate
```
(alex): repro shows the same cuLaunchKernel error on canary-2.
maria: customer impact: approx 1.2% of requests in us-east affected, mostly from new trial accounts routed to canary. escalate to SRE lead and product operations.
liam: recommended live mitigation: 1) stop canary traffic immediately 2) pin traffic to v2.2-stable 3) start rollback/rollforward decision runbook.
alex: executing routing change now. command: ```rbctl route set --pool canary --variant stable --dry-run=false```
devops-bot: routing update accepted, traffic rebalanced to stable pool in ~12s.
alex: monitoring... latency back to baseline in 30s on dashboards. 5xx dropped to normal.
maria: good, canary pool still reporting errors but isolated.
jordan: pulled canary logs; attaching diff of core traces vs stable: https://artifacts.redwood/canary-diffs/2501234567/diff1.txt
(alex): we should capture full timeline for RCA. I'll start a quick doc. nick: tagging SRE/ML infra for kernel/quant analysis. @liam @jordan please collect HW kernels, CUDA versions: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,gpu_name --format=csv`
liam: hosts show driver 535.86, cudnn 9.2, and a mixed runtime on canary nodes (some older container images).
emily: that mismatch could trigger new kernel paths.
maria: action items captured: [A] isolate canary traffic (done), [B] collect core dumps + kernels (jordan), [C] verify image matrix and pin container images (liam), [D] customer comms draft (maria).
jordan: uploading core dumps: https://logs.redwood/dumps/2501234567.tar.gz
alex: rolling handoff in 30m to next on-call. creating a short incident summary for CS: "Canary model v2.3-quant triggered GPU kernel failures in canary pool; immediate rollback to v2.2-stable restored service for customers; investigating quant/kernel mismatch."
nora: I'll own postmortem timeline and RCA doc. pls drop any missing links in thread.
maria: also check pinning: confirm no other rollouts scheduled for next 24h. product: pause all auto-rollouts.
liam: running check: `rbctl rollout list --status pending` returns one (internal-abtest) -> pausing now.
alex: before handoff, final confirm: stable pool healthy, error rates normal, customers unaffected. last check at 14:19 UTC.
IncidentBot: Note: on-call handoff queued, reminder at 14:42 UTC.
nora: thanks all — I'll compile timeline + hypothesis matrix and start the in-incident RCA thread with diffs and logs attached. assigning owners for long-term fixes (kernel patch verification, stronger canary gating).
emily: quick FYI: engineering will schedule a controlled re-rollout after reproducer and kernel check, likely use v2.3-quant with pinned driver and container image matrix.
alex: leaving channel for now, oncall->nora in 30. :white_check_mark:
